title: Colossal Oni Mountain
description: A massive green demonic oni-like creature forms an entire mountainside, its head and antlers covered in trees and moss. Its mouth is open revealing a miniature landscape inside while waterfalls cascade down its body under a dramatic red sunset sky.
prompt: A gigantic green demonic mountain spirit with glowing red eyes and massive antlers covered in hanging moss and pine trees, its body formed from rocky cliffs with waterfalls cascading down its chest, open mouth revealing a miniature world inside, standing in a misty landscape with smaller mountains and red sun in the background, dramatic red and orange sky, surreal fantasy scene
